items.name: Almaty New Year 2026
items.information: Almaty New Year 2026 — Алматы қаласында қысқы ашатын ашық жарыс. Кез келген пәндер санына қатысу үшін базалық жарна – 4000 теңге. Бұл жарысты QBERS командасы ұйымдастырады. **English** Almaty New Year 2026 is an open competition opening the winter season in Almaty. The base registration fee for participation in any number of events is 4000 tenge. This competitions is organized by the QBERS team.

items.name: Cebu New Year Open 2026

venue.name: Banilad Town Centre
venue.address: Gov. M. Cuenco Ave, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu

items.information: ## **Welcome to the 2nd World Cube Association Cebu New Year Open!** This competition marks the second year kick-off competition held in Cebu City. The event is open to anyone able to solve a cube. All other necessary information about the competition can be found in the following tabs above. Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating. ###### *By registering, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge that the organizing bodies, their staff, and affiliated individuals will not be liable for any injuries, loss of personal belongings, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this competition.*

items.name: Cubes Tranchés à Québec AM 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQyOTk4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b8a2a32ac5b3eb36e22a10a8db66703f0a66647a/Club%20de%20Speedcubing%20de%20l%E2%80%99Universit%C3%A9%20Laval.png) ### [FR] #### Série Cubes Tranchés à Québec AM/PM 2026 Une journée, deux compétitions! Vous pouvez choisir entre [Cubes Tranchés à Québec AM 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubesTranchesaQuebecAM2026) et [Cubes Tranchés à Québec PM 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubesTranchesaQuebecPM2026). Ces compétitions ont des épreuves différentes. Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à ***une seule*** des deux compétitions. ***Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plus d'une de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée***. #### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. #### Inscription gratuite pour les membres de CubingUL Les membres du Club de Speedcubing de l'Université Laval peuvent s'inscrire sans frais. Si vous êtes membre, inscrivez votre IDUL dans la zone des commentaires lorsque vous vous inscrivez puis ne payez pas les frais d'inscription. --- ### [EN] #### Cubes Tranchés à Québec AM/PM 2026 Series One day, two competitions! You can choose between [Cubes Tranchés à Québec AM 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubesTranchesaQuebecAM2026) and [Cubes Tranchés à Québec PM 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubesTranchesaQuebecPM2026). These competitions have different events. You can only participate to ***one*** of the two competitions. ***If you register to both of them, only one registration will be accepted***. #### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. #### Free registration for CubingUL members Members of the Laval University Speedcubing Club may register for free by writing their IDUL in the registration comments

items.name: FMC Tijuas I 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQwNjc0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--43d3d648256543b9d089065ceb9de3a8651496ef/Logo%20FMC%20Tijuas%202026%20HD.png) Baja Cubing te invita a FMC Tijuas I 2026, la primera competencia oficial en México este año. Participa en FMC y eventos silenciosos, demuestra tu concentración y busca la solución con la menor cantidad de movimientos. ¡Inicia el 2026 compitiendo con mente fría y estrategia! **Esta competencia no incluye 3x3** **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) y Baja Cubing con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ Baja Cubing invites you to FMC Tijuas I 2026, the first official competition in Mexico this year. Take part in FMC and silent events, show your focus, and aim for the fewest moves possible. Start 2026 with strategy and precision! **This competition does not include 3x3** NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) and Baja Cubing for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.name: Georgia Quiet Championship 2026
items.information: This competition has **only Blindfolded and Fewest Moves events**. If you are a first-time competitor and are interested in competing in regular events like 3x3, you may want to compete at the main [Georgia Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GeorgiaChampionship2026) in Dalton two weeks later instead. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTE3NDgwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3df435f99b10bc79129b5dc96c89c341405a2965/Screenshot%202025-08-04%20at%2012.37.18%E2%80%AFPM.png) All competitors who officially [declare their residency on their CubingUSA account](https://cubingusa.org/edit) in Georgia by **Tuesday, December 30, 2025 at 7:00 PM Eastern** will be eligible for Georgia Champion titles. Please note that you may be asked to verify your residency at the competition with identifying documentation if you achieve a Georgia Champion title. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GeorgiaChampionship2026#62006-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.

items.name: Sofia Open 2026
items.information: Maximum 1 guest per competitor. Registration fee to be paid by bank transfer no more than 48 hours after you have been added to the accepted list. You can choose on which day of the competition you will participate or both. The address of the Technical university of Sofia is 8 Kliment Ohridski boulevard, but the entrance of the venue is on Rosario street. The venue hall number is 4244 (Campus 4, floor 2, hall 44). ---------- Допустими са максимум 1 гост с всеки състезател. Таксата за участие се заплаща по банков път до 48 часа след като сте били добавени в списъка с одобрените участници. Можете да избирате в кой от дните ще се състезавате или и в двата. Адресът на ТУ-София е: гр. София, бул. Климент Охридски 8, но входът за събитието е откъм улица Росарио. Залата е с номер 4244, т.е. блок 4, ет. 2, зала 44.

items.name: Weston-super-Mare Winter 2026
items.information: If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. **Spectators may attend for free!** [![UKCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1c7aaa67674e675ba6f477cf783142702a671457/UKCA_Logo.png)](https://www.ukca.org/) [![Kewbz](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1Y0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b3fb56d1f073b7544d2cf011acfe92e29f237f69/Kewbz_Logo.png)](https://ukspeedcubes.co.uk/) **PLEASE NOTE**: For this competition, there will be competitor limits for some events: ***- 6x6 and 7x7: first 40 to register*** ***- 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded: first 16 to register*** Spaces are available on a first come first served basis. If you are amongst the first 40 (6x6/7x7) or first 16 (Multi-Blind) to register for those events, you will get a space in them. If you are not within the first people registered, your registration for that event will be removed after the close of registration. However we will be keeping waiting list for these specific events in the case of dropouts before registration closes. Please only consider registering for these events if you are certain you would like to compete in them.
